assertions.name: tr_M_and_J_Hopf_are_distinct_symbolically
assertions.source: Markov trace and Jones polynomial differ by writhe-correction; see Kauffman bracket / Markov stabilisation conventions

description: Genuine V_(2,1) Hoefsmit seminormal Markov-trace computation of σ_1² in H_2(q), as a polynomial in q (not hardcoded). Companion / replacement for PR #664's tautological probe_hopf_jones_c3_categorical.py.  Shows that tr_M(σ_1²) and the textbook Jones polynomial -(q+q⁻¹) are DIFFERENT objects; equating them requires writhe/framing-correction conventions PR #664 did not justify.
caveats: This probe DOES NOT derive c_3 = -2.  PR #664's claim that c_3 = J_Hopf(q=1) = -2 rests on (a) identifying tr_M with the Jones polynomial via a specific convention, AND (b) extracting the order-h^6 coefficient of the full Q_β expansion to show this Hopf contribution is the dominant one. Neither is demonstrated in PR #664.  This probe only shows what tr_M(σ_1²) actually equals — namely (q²+q⁻²)/[2]_q, evaluating to +1 at q=1, NOT -2.

A genuine c_3 = -2 categorical derivation would require: (1) build V_(2,1)⊗V_(2,1) Schur-Weyl decomposition in H_6; (2) project onto V_(2,2,2); (3) show this projection produces an h^6-order Markov contribution proportional to the Jones value of the Hopf closure; (4) verify no other order-h^6 contribution survives the Frobenius selection.  All four steps are open work.

Infrastructure issue: the codebase has TWO different tr_M implementations that produce different symbolic answers for the same braid: hoefsmit_symbolic.tr_M_symbolic uses Σ_λ w_λ·χ^λ/f^λ while markov_weights_symbolic.tr_M_canonical uses Σ_λ y_λ·χ^λ (Wenzl's principal-specialization Jones-Markov weights).  Neither matches the textbook Jones polynomial -(q+q⁻¹) directly.  An equivalence script y_lambda_equivalence_proof.py exists but the symbolic outputs of the two routines do NOT agree on σ_1² in H_2. Resolution: ratify one as canonical and audit downstream consumers (proton, neutron, deuteron mass chains all use hoefsmit_symbolic.tr_M_symbolic; the precision-ladder Q_β framework cites tr_M_canonical via thm:jones-markov-trace).
